newsitem.title: USA: CYBEX, Trotter to merge in stock swap.
newsitem.headline: CYBEX, Trotter to merge in stock swap.

text.p: CYBEX International Inc and Trotter Inc said Monday they had a definitive agreement to merge through an exchange of shares.
The fitness equipment companies said in a joint statement that Trotter, a unit of UM Holdings Ltd, will get enough CYBEX shares to have a 50.001 percent pro forma ownership position in CYBEX.
Current CYBEX shareholders will continue to own the remaining 49.999 percent.
UM Holdings is a privately held holding company controlled by John Aglialoro and Joan Carter.
The companies said John Spratt, chairman of CYBEX, and Ray Elliott, president and chief executive, will leave CYBEX after the close of the merger.
John Aglialoro, chairman and chief executive of UM Holdings, will be the chairman of the new entity, and Peter Haines, chief executive officer of Trotter, will be chief executive.
CYBEX said the merger will enhance earnings per share in 1997 and 1998.
